"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"- **一键更新**:发现新版本后,通过 `npx` 拉取最新 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 并自动重启。"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 安装"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"重启一次 web 服务,然后打开 设置 → **DSH Web 服务**。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 工作原理"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"宿主半提供 `GET /dsh-web-manager/status`、`GET /dsh-web-manager/check`、`POST /dsh-web-manager/restart`、`PO"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ST /dsh-web-manager/update`、`POST /dsh-web-manager/stop`;写操作要求同源请求。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"重启与更新使用小型看门狗链:替换实例以独立进程会话(`detached: true`)启动,**先于**旧进程退役。因为 SIGTERM 会让 harness 销毁整个组合 —— 包括所有托管子进程;"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"只有脱离进程组的替换实例能在这场清理中存活下来。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 注意事项"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **停止**会关掉你正在使用的 GUI;重新启动需在终端运行 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`。

- 安装插件意味"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"着以你的权限运行第三方代码。本插件会停止、启动和更新 web 服务进程,在重要环境安装前请阅读源码。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## English"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Features"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Status panel** (Settings → DSH Web 服务): running state, version, port, PID, session uptime.
- **R"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"estart**: detaches a replacement instance into its own process session before retiring the current o"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ne, so the new server survives the old process's graceful teardown.
- **Stop**: terminates the curre"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"nt service (this also closes the GUI the panel lives in).
- **Version check**: compares the running "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"version with the npm registry.
- **Update & restart**: pulls the latest `@deepseek-ai/dsh` through `"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"npx` and restarts on it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Restart the web service once, then open Settings → **DSH Web 服务**."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### How it works"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The host half serves `GET /dsh-web-manager/status`, `GET /dsh-web-manager/check`, `POST /dsh-web-man"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ager/restart`, `POST /dsh-web-manager/update`, and `POST /dsh-web-manager/stop`. Mutating routes req"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"uire a same-origin request."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Restart and update use a small watchdog chain: the replacement instance is spawned in its own proces"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s session (`detached: true`) *before* the current process is retired — on SIGTERM the harness dispos"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"es its whole composition, including every managed child process, and a detached replacement is the o"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"nly child that survives that cleanup."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Notes"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Stop** ends the GUI you are using; start it again from a terminal with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"`.
